# Ellen Marsh — Relationship Manager, First Meridian Bank

- **Relationship:** external. Senior relationship manager at **First Meridian Bank**, which holds
  Brandt's **$120M revolving credit facility**. Primary internal contact is CFO
  [Priya Deshmukh](priya-deshmukh.md).
- **Cadence:** quarterly covenant reporting; more often during the current waiver process.
- **The issue:** Brandt **tripped the net-leverage covenant (≤ 3.5x)** in Q2 2026; Ellen's bank
  is processing a **waiver** and a possible amend-and-extend. See
  [Refinancing](../projects/refinancing.md).
- **Distinguishing fact:** she has been constructive so far, but wants a credible margin-recovery
  plan attached to the waiver — the [OEE program](../projects/operational-excellence.md) and
  [Slate](../projects/slate.md) are that plan (Slate discussed with her **only** in
  de-identified, confidential terms).

## How to work with her
- Reward her constructiveness with no surprises; give bad news early and with a plan.

## Sensitivities
- The **signed covenant-waiver letter** back to First Meridian is **overdue** (see
  [commitments](../commitments.md)).
